visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up shot of two cats—one ginger and white, the other a calico—sleeping peacefully on a soft, dark-colored cushion. Large Traditional Chinese text overlays the center of the frame. The setting is a brightly lit indoor home. (2) The scene cuts to a tortoiseshell cat lying on a gray fabric surface. A human hand enters the frame from the right and gently strokes the cat's head. The background shows the warm wood of a bed frame or headboard. (3) A montage follows, showing a tabby cat sleeping on a light gray pillow, followed by a white and gray cat resting its head on its paws against a white wall. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout. (4) The tortoiseshell cat is shown sitting up with its eyes narrowed to slits, eventually opening them wide to reveal striking green irises. (5) A tabby cat is filmed sleeping with its chin resting directly on a white computer keyboard. A human hand is visible to the right, typing on the keys. A computer monitor with a video editing interface is visible in the background. (6) A white cat with gray spots is shown sleeping on its back on a light-colored wooden desk, its mouth slightly open and paws curled. A small wooden decorative item is on the left. (7) The final phase features a ginger tabby cat sitting next to a smartphone on a desk. The cat's eyes are half-closed before it blinks. The brand logo and social media handle appear in the corner.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR. [Slogan]: 我的貓怎麼整天都在睡？ (2) [Subtitle]: 欸醒醒啊. (3) [Subtitle]: 早上睡下午睡晚上也睡. (4) [Subtitle]: 我的貓咪怎麼一整天都在睡？ (5) [Subtitle]: 一般貓咪呢一整天的睡眠時間. (6) [Subtitle]: 大概是12-16個小時. (7) [Subtitle]: 大家是不是聽到這裡覺得哇塞也太久了吧！ (8) [Subtitle]: 但其實他們雖然睡眠時間聽起來很長. (9) [Subtitle]: 但是大部分的貓咪們呢睡覺時間呢都屬於淺眠狀態. (10) [Subtitle]: 他們休息時會趴著或是坐著瞇起眼睛. (11) [Subtitle]: 但只要有一點點動靜他們馬上就會睜開眼睛觀察四周. (12) [Subtitle]: 真的進入熟睡的時間呢其實只有5-6個小時. (13) [Subtitle]: 這個時候貓咪們會全身放鬆. (14) [Subtitle]: 最常見是他們整隻側躺睡著. (15) [Subtitle]: 或是用手手把臉遮住睡覺. (16) [Subtitle]: 像本丸就常常睡到把肚子都翻出來朝外. (17) [Subtitle]: 其實這種狀態才是他們真正進入睡眠狀態的時候哦！ (18) [Subtitle]: 有的貓咪甚至會在這個時候出現了手腳或是嘴巴微微抽動的現象. (19) [Subtitle]: 這就表示他們睡得很熟熟到在做夢！ (20) [Subtitle]: 所以說呢貓咪們雖然看起來一整天好像都在睡覺. (21) [Subtitle]: 但是其實他們睡得比我們還少喲！ (22) [Logo]: 我是好味小姐. [Slogan]: 養貓知識那你知道了嗎？

By distinguishing between light sleep and deep REM sleep, it provides value and scientific knowledge to pet owners in an accessible, lighthearted format typical of the 'Lady Flavor' brand identity.
